p: curtains: That is, in tents covered with skin.
all that is in thine heart: As yet God had not revealed to the prophet what he purposed concerning David, therefore seeing God favoured David, he spoke what he thought.
night: After Nathan had spoken to David.
tent to tent: That is, in a tent which moved to and fro.
walked with all Israel: Meaning, wherever his ark went, which was a sign of his presence.
even from following the sheep: Of a shepherd of sheep I made you a shepherd of men: so that you did not come to this dignity through your own merits, but by my pure grace.
plant them: Make them sure that they will not move.
build thee an house: Will give you great posterity.
ever: That is, to the coming of Christ: for then these figures would cease.
came and sat before the LORD: He went into the tent where the Ark was, showing what we should do when we receive any benefits from the Lord.
hitherto: Meaning to this kingly estate.
high degree: You have promised a kingdom that will continue to me and my posterity and that Christ will proceed from me.
heart: Freely and according to the purpose of your will, without any deserving.
Israel: That is, he shows himself indeed to be their God, by delivering them from dangers, and preserving them.
told thy servant that thou wilt: You have declared to me by Nathan the prophet.
